findings.title: Vendor-path static gate never visits class-method or top-level arrow initializer call sites
findings.call_reachability: Actual production calls exist in NarralensHost server.ts:529, CommittedSnapshotAuthority:298/366/403, CreatedNativeWorkspaceService:532/551, and OpenFilmStudioSupervisor:342. buildScopes enumerates module FunctionDeclaration and ExpressionStatement only; ClassDeclaration and VariableStatement initializer bodies never enter calls. Thus productionSources() including their file is not equivalent to inspecting these calls.
findings.contract_violated: N1N2 existing_behavior / loader regression gate must reject request-derived vendor paths at actual Host call sites and cover helper/alias/namespace/local paths; assertion at line713 claims all Host sites.
findings.trigger: A request-derived call inside a class method, e.g. class Handler { run(incoming: IncomingMessage) { createPinnedOpenFilmUpstream(incoming.url as string); } }, or top-level const handler=(incoming: IncomingMessage)=>createPinnedOpenFilmUpstream(incoming.url as string), produces no collected call regardless of taint. This is a source-proven test blind spot, NOT a claim that the current runtime vendor path is user-controlled.
findings.counterexample_execution: NOT_RUN by authorization; deterministic AST branch analysis only. No test/build/import executed.
findings.minimal_fix: Extend lexical traversal and taint bindings to actual function-like nodes including methods, constructors, arrow/function expressions and their initializers; include local callable aliases where promised. Add synthetic refusal vectors shaped like real class methods and arrow callbacks and verify actual production loader sites are enumerated. Re-run affected lock test/full gates via MAIN authorized writer, then re-freeze for independent review.
findings.acceptance_effect: REQUEST_CHANGES for test validity; no claim of active secret leak or reachable runtime exploit.

findings.title: Clean checkout verification has explicit external environment prerequisites
findings.call_reachability: Real component fixtures load fixed vendorRoot and approved expected module from var; pnpm build does not regenerate Approved015.
findings.trigger: Fresh machine without fixed upstream checkout/dependencies or the separately approved five files cannot execute full component gates.
findings.minimal_fix: Retain explicit prerequisite provisioning/version/hash instructions. This is an acknowledged deployment prerequisite, not an omitted N1N2 source file; do not promise environment-free clean checkout execution.

findings.title: Default fullcheck retains one real-tools opt-in NOT_RUN
